title: Hexcode Breach Lite
description: A lightweight Cyberpunk-style hexcode breach minigame for Foundry VTT v12 and Cyberpunk RED v0.92.1. v1.0.5 verification candidate adds an explicit CitiNet/companion-module outcome contract with full success, partial success, failure, and aborted states; fires the close hook after the player window actually closes; and preserves the validated v1.0.4 helper icon and v1.0.3 Monk's Active Tile Triggers behavior, scene-local puzzle libraries, strict Netrunner access, customizable 4x4-8x8 grids and 4-14 slot buffers, repeatable hexcodes, audited emergency resets, and Eurobucks, Item, and RollTable rewards.
